rationale: The typed preparation profile is explicitly and immutably versioned.
The contextual certification_profile declaration is part of beta-0.7 syntax.
Strings identifiers integers decimals and booleans remain distinct AST values.
Product identity binds version owner release class deployment geography and validity.
Useful work has a positive denominator unit success condition metric and quality floor.
Workload size concurrency runs traffic and cache state are bounded and typed.
Included and excluded components use a closed boundary domain.
Exclusions require reasons bounded percentages and cumulative threshold compliance.
AI roles scope and native lifecycle booleans bind responsibility.
Accuracy latency error functional security accessibility and privacy floors are mandatory.
Calendar dates must be real and the profile start must precede its end.
Profile links resolve deterministically after collecting the complete source unit.
Wrong literal types and field cardinality fail closed.
Unknown enum or domain members fail closed.
Out-of-range numeric values fail closed.
Unknown linked declarations fail closed.
A reference bound to the wrong declaration kind fails closed.
A v2-linked declaration missing v2-only fields fails closed.
Legacy v1 sources remain accepted and produce deterministic review-required migration output.
Evidence preserves integers decimals and booleans as native JSON values.
Profile conformance cannot grant certification or create a production claim.
